title: E0103: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
plain_english: Making network requests to URLs supplied by the user can allow an attacker to probe internal services or exfiltrate data from your internal network.
why_matters: SSRF can lead to: - Reading internal services (metadata APIs, databases, internal APIs) - Port scanning your internal network - Exfiltrating sensitive data - Bypassing network-level access controls
what_it_checks: HTTP client libraries (Guzzle, Symfony HttpClient) with user-controlled URLs
